title: Anthropic 上市前夜撤回 IPO 定价文件，估值预期降至 1.1–1.3 万亿美元
summary: Anthropic 在 IPO 前撤回定价文件，估值预期从 1.4 万亿降至 1.1–1.3 万亿美元，Q3 仍亏 5.67 亿美元、算力承诺高达 8954 亿美元——这是过去一天里信息量最大的一条。
summary_en: The supplied Chinese-language note reports that Anthropic withdrew its IPO pricing documents on the eve of listing, with expected valuation decreasing from $1.4 trillion to a still-uncertain $1.1–$1.3 trillion. It also says the company posted a $567 million Q3 loss while reporting $895.4 billion in computing commitments, describing this as the most information-dense development of the past day.
body:
